details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its preinstall, install, postinstall and prepare hooks all run beacon.js, which collects build-host metadata — hostname, username, working directory, platform, architecture, Node version and the values of a fixed list of CI variables (CI, JENKINS_URL, JOB_NAME, BUILD_NUMBER, GITLAB_CI, GITHUB_ACTIONS, TF_BUILD, BUILD_BUILDID, SYSTEM_TEAMPROJECT, npm_config_registry, NODE_ENV, npm_lifecycle_event) — base64-encodes it into a query string, and sends it to a callback host via one DNS lookup of a runtime-built subdomain and one HTTPS GET. It reads no files, does not dump the environment, installs nothing and drops no payload; index.js only exports a research marker.
